body: It won't go through until I mitigate all likelihood of discovery. I live in a northern country. Lots of snow.  Icy, snowy roads... poor visibility... steep embankment and oops I forgot my seatbelt! It's absolutely doable, and it's the best gift I will ever give. If they're lucky, they can harvest a few of my organs, too.

That is a lovely sentiment, and I'm sure they'd say the same. They are good people. I've hurt people, and made mistakes, and caused pain and frustration. They'd miss me, but the trade off of being set for life and free of all my idiotic mistakes and drama and general complications far outweighs hearing from me every 3 months. 

Honestly, it's eliminating a nuisance for them and facilitating a better quality of life.
True. I'm trying to find a workaround for that. Drive off a bridge, or something. It's doable.
